claim: Where auto cannot make an NXC patch, give each build option its own byte so each variant is a valid menu toggle, use --start and --tape-bank for tape games, and rebuild every option byte for byte from the patch and tape.

evidence.text: One byte per build option (25 fps 2 bytes, smooth 1, car 1), verified per variant; --tape-bank 8,9,11; build_screen points at the tape's screen; each variant's MD5 rebuilt from the tape and the loader run on the Z80 harness.
This repo's packager could not make an option needing more memory (SET3) until nexclash/nxc.py was re-vendored.
